name: Hyouryuu Kangoku Chronos
source:
Chronos wanders in the space...
In the Forest Belt, regarded as a taboo area, an operative ship named Chronos that went missing 80 years ago was discovered. 

Emina and her co-workers stepped into this ship to get some materials to fix their battleship without knowing what was awaiting them...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE131356.html]DLsite English[/url]]
